summary: Independent tracked source denominator for backend/router/ORM/settings/registries/jobs/CLI/MCP; syntax and conservative candidate links, no ledger or app import.

Generated JSON/MD not inputs, review ledger not input, no automatic upgrade of reviewed status

errors: Missing tracked input or invalid Python/JSON fails; unmatched generated bytes check exits1
Conservative alias/dynamic links require manual reading; no runtime OpenAPI/ORM reflection
